format.wav.label: WAV
format.wav.title: The soundtrack only, uncompressed (32-bit float WAV), nothing is rendered
format.made: {codec} video with {audio, select, aac {AAC} opus {Opus} pcm {uncompressed} other {AAC}} audio
codec.h264.label: H.264
codec.h264.title: Plays everywhere
codec.hevc.label: HEVC
codec.hevc.title: About a third smaller than H.264 at the same quality. Made by your graphics card. Windows needs Microsoft's HEVC Video Extensions to play it
codec.av1.label: AV1
codec.av1.title: About half the size of H.264 at the same quality. Fast with a recent graphics card, slower without one. Plays in browsers, on YouTube and in Windows 11
codec.vp9.label: VP9
codec.vp9.title: Plays in every browser
codec.cineform.label: CineForm (for editing)
codec.cineform.title: GoPro CineForm, for editing in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and After Effects: large files that stay sharp through more editing. Can be transparent
codec.animation.label: Lossless
codec.animation.title: QuickTime Animation: lossless and transparent, very large. For short overlays
codec.prores422.label: ProRes 422
codec.prores422.title: For Final Cut Pro and Apple workflows. FFmpeg's ProRes encoder, not certified by Apple
codec.prores4444.label: ProRes 4444
codec.prores4444.title: ProRes with transparency. FFmpeg's ProRes encoder, not certified by Apple
notice.cannotMake: This PC cannot make {codec}, so this export uses {fallback}.
hint.av1Cpu: AV1 on the processor takes about 6 times as long as H.264: roughly {time} for this video.
hint.cineform: About {size} for this {length} video. Editing formats ignore Target size.
hint.animation: Up to {size} for this {length} video, more with motion.
fps.24.title: The film rate. Scrolling looks less smooth than at 30
fps.25.title: The TV rate in Europe, Africa, South Asia and Australia
fps.120.title: For 120 Hz screens. Most sites play at most 60 fps. Exports take about twice as long as 60 fps
fps.no4k120: H.264 cannot carry 4K at 120 fps. Choose HEVC or AV1, or 1440p.
fps.4kAt60: 4K with H.264 is exported at 60 fps.
aspect.45.title: Export in 4:5 (1080×1350 at 1080p); the project keeps its own shape
target.editing: Editing formats are sized by quality, not by a target.
target.transparent: Transparent videos are sized by quality, not by a target.
encoder.hevcSoftware: HEVC uses your graphics card only
webcodecs.unsupported: The graphics card cannot make {codec} at {width}×{height} on this PC.
